GO

GO

CREATE PROC [BNKM].[SP_BranchGroupBranch_DEP] AS
BEGIN

--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupBranch AS 
(
SELECT
	BDS.SET_ID AS BranchGroupId
	,BDS.SOL_ID AS BranchId
	,BDS.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,CASE 
		WHEN BDS.SET_ID like 'AR%' THEN 'Branch Area'
		WHEN BDS.SET_ID like 'REG%' THEN 'Branch Region' 
		END AS BranchRelatedRegionTypeId
	,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,BDS.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
    ,BDSD.RECORD_STATUS
FROM BUSC.DEP_SOLIDSETTABLE_DELTA BDSD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_SOLIDSETTABLE BDS ON BDSD.SET_ID = BDS.SET_ID AND BDSD.BANK_ID = BDS.BANK_ID AND BDS.ISLATEST = 1
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupBranch FROM TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupBranch;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupBranch_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
BranchGroupId
,BranchId
,FinancialInstitutionId
,BranchRelatedRegionTypeId
)) HASHROW, BranchGroupId, RECORD_STATUS 
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupBranch WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupBranch_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
BranchGroupId
,BranchId
,FinancialInstitutionId
,BranchRelatedRegionTypeId
)) HASHROW, BranchGroupId
FROM BNKM.BranchGroupBranch WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'	
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupBranch_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.BranchGroupId,TGT.BranchGroupId) AS BranchGroupId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupBranch_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupBranch_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.BranchGroupId = TGT.BranchGroupId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupBranch_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupBranch_DELTA;

---------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
	BranchGroupId = SRC.BranchGroupId
	,BranchId = SRC.BranchId
	,FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,BranchRelatedRegionTypeId = SRC.BranchRelatedRegionTypeId
	,SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
	,TaskRunId = 0
	,WorkFlowId = 0
	,InsertDttm = SRC.InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.BranchGroupBranch TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupBranch_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.BranchGroupId = TGT.BranchGroupId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupBranch SRC ON SRC.BranchGroupId = TGT.BranchGroupId ;

 
-------INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.BranchGroupBranch
(
	BranchGroupId
	,BranchId
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,BranchRelatedRegionTypeId
	,SourceSystemCode
	,TaskRunId
	,WorkFlowId
	,InsertDttm
)
SELECT
	BranchGroupId
	,BranchId
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,BranchRelatedRegionTypeId
	,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupBranch
WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupBranch;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_BranchGroupBranch_DELTA;

END
GO
